objective: Train experimental no-guard Dreamer PPO and Dreamer SDBS variants without overwriting the guarded SimLingo+Dreamer runtime checkpoints.

runtime_contract.production_rule: Never install an RL checkpoint as latest runtime unless it passes the dataset audit, closed-loop smoke tests, and KPI comparison against the guarded checkpoint.

training_stages.name: offline_world_model_warmstart
training_stages.description: Train only the world model on audited SimLingo/Dreamer traces. This gives the scorer a realistic prior before closed-loop RL.

training_stages.name: closed_loop_smoke
training_stages.description: Small real CARLA run to verify device placement, logging, checkpoint writing, and no immediate policy collapse.

training_stages.name: closed_loop_rl
training_stages.description: Longer PPO/SDBS training. Checkpoint is experimental until benchmarked in the dashboard.

training_stages.name: dashboard_kpi_validation
training_stages.description: Compare native SimLingo, guarded Dreamer PPO, guarded SDBS, and the two RL no-guard variants on the same route/scenario families.
